title.zh-CN: 人物城市旅行拼贴海报

description.zh-CN: 围绕上传人物与指定城市，制作带地标、美食、地图、票据和邮戳的复古旅行拼贴海报。预览为自制示意，未用原帖照片编辑复测。 来源案例仅作视觉参考，生成效果尚未在本模板中复测。
description.en-US: Vintage City Travel Collage Portrait. The source example is a visual reference, not a verified output of this preset.

zh-CN.prompt: 以有权使用的参考照片中的人物为主角，创作「{cityName}」主题复古旅行拼贴海报，保留人物的五官辨识度、自然神态和真实肤色。用醒目的「{cityNameEn}」复古粗体标题，搭配该城市真实而可辨识的地标、街景、美食、地图轮廓、虚构票据和邮戳，结合撕纸边缘、细腻印刷颗粒与少量不涉及事实陈述的手写短句，构图丰富、层次清晰。以中性米白纸底搭配从城市景象提取的蓝绿和砖红，适度减少黄调，保留复古纸感但不让人物泛黄。只输出海报平面图，不要实体海报模型、真实品牌标识、未经证实的到访日期或水印。

en-US.prompt: Using a portrait you have the right to use, make its person the protagonist of a vintage travel collage poster for {cityName}. Preserve their recognizable facial features, natural expression and realistic skin tone. Feature the bold vintage title '{cityNameEn}' alongside genuine recognizable landmarks, streets, food and map silhouettes of the city, plus fictional tickets and postmarks. Combine torn-paper edges, fine print grain and a few handwritten phrases that make no factual claims. Build a rich but clear layered composition on neutral off-white paper, with blue-green and brick-red accents sampled from the city scene. Reduce yellow cast while retaining a tactile vintage feel and natural skin. Output only the flat poster design, not a physical poster mockup, real brand marks, an unverified visit date or watermark.
